# openwrt_uci_order (Resource)

Keeps the listed sections of a config in the given order (they are moved to the top of the file). Use it for firewall rules and redirects, which are evaluated in file order. Destroying it leaves the order as is.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Config file name, e.g. `firewall`.
- `sections` (List of String) Section names in the desired order, e.g. `[openwrt_firewall_rule.a.section, ...]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
